current.text: He has a torn ACL and is out now. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.
He is expected to miss most of the season. He might return around the halfway point.

durable.text: He is a very good rebounder.
His shooting has not come around.
He can play some center next to Siakam. That lineup worked last season.
He scores very little. His projected points are far below the top 250 pool.

tags.name: injured now
tags.detail: Torn ACL. Yahoo status O (Knee). Might be back around midseason.

note: Don't draft him in our league. Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 426, ESPN rank 320), and a torn ACL will keep him out for most of the season. Even healthy, ESPN projects only 16.1 minutes and 4.5 points per game, which is far below the 144-player line, so he is not a waiver target either unless a midseason return comes with a bigger role.
